raw_parent_operands: raw-parent-operands holds exact Git parent inputs. In particular theirs44.session.json is the original final44 checkpoint, not the owner-selected input.
derived_operands: derived/base.json and derived/theirs.json are root-selected helper inputs with superseded active references removed; derived/theirs.json also aligns the complete incoming current-cycle group to base. derived/ours.json is the supported helper output selected by root. These derived inputs are not historical parent bytes.
scope: Retire only superseded active pointers while retaining all underlying records/artifacts and direct checkpoint file protection. No product bound or cleanup behavior changes.
